decision.reason: [ev-d217f6ac2a1d] is only a table-of-contents link title in the upgrade guide, and it names no subject, change or consequence. The step-5 content in the section context ([ev-914f3976650c], [ev-238c84f9b428], [ev-4ac01f128e04], [ev-c3c10f1d0eea]) only sends readers to other getting-started and MRD guides that aren't shown here. It presents those features as optional things to try, not as a change that would affect an operator who does nothing. To write the open aspects, we would need text that says concretely what changed and what happens to exposed environments.
